fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Pluto in Aquarius and the Next Generations", "body": "Michael said he treated Saturn as a time clock, and because Saturn was entering Pisces, the last sign of the zodiac, he read 2023 as the beginning of the end of the world as it had been, setting up what he called a literal new world order two years later. Emily argued that children born as Pluto entered Aquarius would eventually dismantle systems that caused harm, that the process might take centuries, and that the ideological clashes of the moment were a renegotiation of consciousness, so the people on the other side were not enemies."}, {"title": "Extinction, Frequencies, and Protecting the Aura", "body": "The conversation turned to mass extinction, and one speaker argued that extinction was really a loss of perception, saying consciousness constricted through fear and expanded through love. The same speaker cited renegade microscopists and friends in Arizona who, they said, saw wildlife return after disrupting cell tower fields with orgone devices. Emily answered that protecting the aura mattered, even though everyone's energetic bodies were connected, and said she coached clients to transform their own piece of the collective field. The first speaker added that a person's health and boundaries decided how much electromagnetic fields affected them."}, {"title": "Astro Yoga and the Body as Compass", "body": "Emily explained that Kundalini practices were aimed at particular energetic outcomes, said she taught hot yoga at a couple of studios, and argued that much of what looked like innovation in spiritual communities was really remembering, adding that astro yoga was thousands of years old. Asked about Capricorn, she tied the sign to the bones and suggested warrior two, or resting with a weighted blanket on the thighs, during the Mercury retrograde. Later she argued that real discernment lived in the physical body, gained through grounding, rest and nervous system care, and she joked that she made her classes massage their feet."}, {"title": "The I Ching, Predictions, and Attention", "body": "Chance reported throwing coins for 2023 and getting hexagram 44, changing to 28, which he read as a warning about excess, worry, obsessiveness and gluttony, and as a call for people who had woken up and the general public to meet halfway. When Nostradamus predictions came up, one speaker argued that dwelling on predictions could help bring them about, that Gemini tempted people to mistake partial views for ultimate truth, and that it was better to place attention on the highest source available."}, {"title": "Saturn, Time, and Nonlocal Consciousness", "body": "The conversation turned to Saturn in Pisces as a harvest of past choices and to the Greek idea of measured time versus subjective time, with one speaker suggesting that meditation and yoga widened the aperture of consciousness. Someone raised the 2022 physics Nobel Prize, and Emily said she told her yoga classes that science had finally caught up. Chance described his distance energy work as a sign that separation was only a concept. Michael said the spiritual cliches he once dismissed, such as that life is what you make it, had become real for him."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Ace astrologer Michael Nnebe Jr, aka The Peace Dealer, returns to Vibe Rant along with Emily Ridout the Astro-Yoga Instructor, for a look ahead at the starry situation we face in 2023. Join us as we discuss the important themes, transits and trigger-points for the next 12 month cycle, and have fun doing it!
